name: Neues
source: One day a forest inspector found in the forest a droid girl, without knowing who created it or why it was left there he decided to bring her to his house. The girl droid got his own feelings and ideas but what is more important she wants to become human not only by her feelings but of fact.
translation: One day a forest inspector found in the forest a droid girl, without knowing who created it or why it was left there he decided to bring her to his house. The girl droid got his own feelings and ideas but what is more important she wants to become human not only by her feelings but of fact.
